displayTitle: The Art of Star Wars: Visions
synopsis: The Art of Star Wars: Visions is a book of concept art and process pieces from the animated television series Star Wars: Visions. An expertly crafted, full-color, oversized volume showcasing the creative forces behind the hotly anticipated animated anthology series! Star Wars: Visions, an original series of animated short films, celebrates the Star Wars galaxy through the lens of the world's best Japanese anime creators. Coming in 2021 to Disney+. Dark Horse Books and Lucasfilm invite fans to enjoy the universe of Star Wars from a thrilling new point of view with The Art of Star Wars: Visions.
title: The Art of Star Wars: Visions
